items.headline: No. 19 Washington matches up against Utah State
items.description: Utah State (0-1) at No. 19 Washington (1-0), Sept. 12 at 3:30 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Mason Lindberg hits 5 field goals to help Idaho State outlast Utah State 29-17
items.description: — Mason Lindberg kicked five field goals, and Idaho State intercepted four passes as the Bengals, ranked No. 23 in the Stats Perform FCS Top 25 Poll, beat FBS-member Utah State 29-17 on Saturday.

items.headline: Notre Dame and Wisconsin's alternates top best jerseys of CFB Week 1
items.description: Both Notre Dame and Wisconsin are pivoting from their usual classic looks for their Week 1 meeting at Lambeau Field.

items.headline: How the rebuilt Pac-12 looks to be 'in a tier of its own'
items.description: Pac-12 After Dark is returning, but will the rebuilt conference be able to find the balance between its past and what it's trying to become?

items.headline: Ranking all 138 FBS teams in tiers: Who rises to the top?
items.description: Presenting a tiered ranking of all 138 FBS teams ahead of the 2026 season.

items.headline: Pac-12, MWC finalize settlement over 'poaching,' exit fees
items.description: The Pac-12 and Mountain West have finalized a settlement over "poaching" and exit fees ahead of a number of former MWC schools heading to the Pac-12.
